metadata.scenario: A daughter calls extremely upset because the home health aide didn't show up this morning. Her mother missed medication. She demands a supervisor callback within the hour or she's switching agencies. Very angry tone throughout.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I assist you today? Hi, this is Dorothy Henderson. I'm really upset right now. My mother was supposed to have a caregiver come this morning, and no one showed up! I’m so sorry to hear that, Dorothy. Let me look into this for you. Can I have your mother's full name, please? It’s Evelyn Henderson. She missed her medication because of this. This is unacceptable! I completely understand your frustration, Dorothy. I will do my best to resolve this quickly. I need a supervisor to call me back within the hour, or I’m switching agencies. I can escalate this right away. Can I confirm your phone number is +13165558734? Yes, that’s correct! Please make sure someone calls me back soon! I will ensure that happens. Just to clarify, your mother receives personal care and physical therapy, correct? Yes, she does, and she prefers female caregivers only. This has been going on for months without issues! Thank you for that information. I will make sure we respect those preferences moving forward. I just can’t believe this happened. What if this happens again? She depends on this care! I truly apologize for the inconvenience. I will also check if we need to adjust her care plan to avoid future issues. Please do! I don’t want to have to deal with this again. Absolutely. Is there anything else I can assist you with while I have you on the line? No, just the callback is all I need right now. Understood, Dorothy. I will make sure a supervisor, Angela Martinez, calls you back within the hour at +13165558734. Thank you. I really hope this gets sorted out. I appreciate your patience. I will also follow up with the caregiver team to understand why this incident occurred. I’ll be waiting for that call. Thank you for bringing this to our attention, Dorothy. We will take care of it immediately. Okay, I hope so. Goodbye. Goodbye, Dorothy. Take care.
